name: Republic of Ragusa
description: A white field bearing the standing figure of St Blaise in bishop's vestments between the initials S and B.
history: Flag of the maritime Republic of Ragusa (Dubrovnik), which kept its independence between Venice and the Ottomans until Napoleon abolished it in 1808. Its motto flag 'LIBERTAS' and the St Blaise banner both flew from its ships.

features.role: St Blaise (Sveti Vlaho), patron of Ragusa
features.symbolism: the city's protector, holding a model of Dubrovnik
